periods.label: Week of August 10, 2026
periods.summaryTitle: Feature enhancements and core system updates

features: Added multiple character support with shared stash inventory, allowing players to create and switch characters within the same account.
Implemented Swarm Mode for waves content, including a realm header toggle and scaled server cooldowns.
Introduced Souls-based ranking on the leaderboard system and updated hero statistics visibility.
Added persistent auto-equip options for items and spells, filling empty equipment or spell slots automatically upon acquisition.
Enhanced Devlog functionality by adding status tracking and dedicated categories for feature/balance requests.
bugfixes: Fixed issues with aura units failing to follow their owning unit when moving across the world map.
Corrected visual glitches, including a fix for gooey swamp lighting and blizzard spell effects.
Addressed UI accessibility concerns by ensuring key preview and Devlog close buttons remain visible in the top-right corner on mobile devices.
balance: Revamped combat rules to standardize status effects, making Poison, Bleed, and Burn ticks bypass dodge and block.
Adjusted Voodoo poison scaling to amplify damage from level 1 to level 99, alongside multiple adjustments to blocking mechanics (e.g., guaranteeing Penance restoration).
Enhanced Thunder Aura by doubling its damage output and widening its targeting radius, while implementing improved ground-level impact visuals.
ux: Streamlined the mobile experience with compacted panels and responsive layouts that do not scale or interfere with the main HUD.
Improved Devlog usability by adding clearer status management and categorization for user requests.
graphics: Updated visual effects for Thunder Aura strikes, replacing simple fills with inward-fading lightning arcs over a 1.5-second duration.
Resolved specific environmental lighting errors related to swamp biomes and blizzard spells.

commits.title: feat(waves): add swarm mode
commits.description:
- add a realm-header toggle with countdown and tooltip
- force queued enemies and advance waves below the active-enemy cap
- enforce wave-scaled server cooldowns and reset the mode for new realms

commits.title: balance(combat): revise status and blocking rules
commits.description:
- scale Voodoo poison amplification from 1x at level 1 to 2x at level 99

- make Poison, Bleed, and Burn ticks bypass dodge and block

- remove Blocking's reactive cooldown and allow consecutive block rolls

- guarantee Penance restores at least 1% of maximum Mana per successful block

- cap buckler, Katar, and Reflective Surge block chance at 90%

- synchronize combat projections, tooltips, specs, and boundary tests
